Oregon Drop Box Locator

 Official Ballot Drop Sites in Oregon

Ballots can be delivered to any Oregon Official Ballot Drop Site during the 20 day voting period until 8:00 PM on Election Day. Voters who are in line at 8:00 PM may drop off their ballot.

For more information about local elections, including drop box locations for your county, contact your County Elections Official.

Find the nearest Official Ballot Drop Sites by entering a full voter registration residence address, including the street and number, city, state and zip code.

If you have trouble with the drop box tool you can use the Voting Information Tool here.

How to recognize an official Oregon website

.gov

Official websites use .gov

A .gov website belongs to an official government organization in the United States.

Secure .gov websites use HTTPS

A lock icon ( ) or https:// means you’ve safely connected to the .gov website.

Only share sensitive information on official, secure websites.
